entry.name: jit.qt.grab
entry.digest: Digitize video from an external source
entry.description: Use the jit.grab object to digitize video from any video digitizer and decompress the signal into a Jitter matrix. On OSX, QuickTime is used; on Windows, DirectX is used.

messages.description: Export the current frame as an image file with the name specified by the first argument. The second argument sets the file type (default = png). Available file types are,, and.You can use the Max Preferences tofor PNG images.

messages.description: Reports the list of available inputs to the video digitizer from the object's right outlet, preceded by the word. Note that the digitizer must bein order for this method to function.
